title: First band, the Ohio Lucky Seven, and jazz outside New Orleans
summary: His first band in Defiance was the Ohio Lucky Seven; he argues fine jazz musicians came from places like Indiana, such as Bix.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: My first band? Yeah Well, In Defiance, where I was born It was a very fine band too I mean, it really was a good jazz band for those days It was called the Ohio Lucky Seven And it's just too bad that we didn't record for Jeanette in those days Because we did have it down pretty good, you know And that's why I always laugh when someone said, you know They always say, well, if you don't come from New Orleans Or if you don't come from certain parts of the country, you're not supposed to play But there were, some of the finest musicians have come from Indiana Sure they did, oh yeah And, well, Bix for instance, and those kind of guys I'm sure they had no one to follow at that time They had to come up with their own ideas, I'm sure they did
